Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 144. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 10 ki (Special)
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: self (100 foot line)
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: beam
A very powerful move that resembles a drill. Targets
in this 5 ft wide, 100 foot long line must make a
dexterity saving throw or take 2d10 Ki damage for every
10 ki spent. This damage can not be reduced by
blocking.
The maximum dice amount (this is considered the
d10s BEFORE bonuses like increased damage die) can
not exceed your total character level.
